_doc: Copy to config.json and edit. Changes apply without restarting. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_partner_key: Secret for your partner (e.g. an AI companion). Requests with 'Authorization: Bearer <partner_key>' act as the partner; /mcp, /api/partner/* and cli/stopover.py need it. Empty = partner features are view-only in the web page and no AI can call in. Generate one: python3 -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"
_features: share=false hides every hand-over / conversation / inbox UI in the web page.
_public_url: Where this site is reachable, e.g. https://example.com — used for absolute links in webhooks, pushes and cards. Empty = relative links.
_inject: When I hand something to the partner: wait until merge_seconds have passed quietly, then POST {text, shares, images, cards, replies} as JSON to url (with extra headers). Empty url = nothing is sent; the partner pulls GET /api/partner/inbox instead. template variables: {me} {partner} {body} {n}. A failed POST is retried once, then left in the inbox.
_push: Push to my devices when the partner comments, hands me something or stars a city. web: Web Push (VAPID keys are generated into var/vapid.json on first use). apns: native iOS app — key_path is the .p8 auth key file, env is the default gateway for tokens that do not say.
